description.value: Blenz Coffee at International Village is a location of a BC-founded specialty coffee chain situated in downtown Vancouver near Chinatown and Gastown. The cafe offers espresso drinks, nitro coffee, whole-leaf teas, and a full food menu spanning pastries, sandwiches, wraps, and desserts. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, making it a practical urban rest stop for cyclists passing through the core.
